figurative_meaning_en: Enjoying the warmth of the fire
example_sentences_in_bangla: শীতকালে গ্রামের বাড়িতে অগ্নিসেবন করে গল্প করা খুব মজার।
আমরা কাঠ জ্বালিয়ে অগ্নিসেবন করছিলাম সন্ধ্যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: In winter, sitting by the fire in the village home and chatting is very enjoyable.
We were enjoying the warmth of the fire in the evening after lighting wood.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali practices of gathering around wood fires for warmth and social bonding in colder months.
